source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide whether a profit percentage is being measured against investment cost or against revenue.
node_labels: Number: magnitude, representation and arithmetic structure

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Investment cost is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether a profit percentage is being measured against' is answered as investment cost rather than profit amount.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: profit amount still holds here even though The same profit amount can give different percentages when the base changes from cost to is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide whether a profit percentage is being measured.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is profit amount because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Decide whether a profit percentage is being measured against' as the operative test.

intelligence.enrichment: Profit percentage uses the cost price when asking how much profit was made compared with what was invested, but uses revenue when asking how much profit was made on overall sales.
